sources_read: .qc-cache/kittle-2026-10-09-r1/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx: 'Quality Checks' row 49 (#48 dimension_prompts_are_accurate_and_consistent) and 'Internal Quality Checks' row 49 (same text)
task/solution/app/public/app.js, server.js (keyword check that named screens exist)
evidence: All five dimension prompts plus app_context describe this app with no judge-facing residue. (1) app_context.md:3 'Kittle & Rowe matter chat', :8-16 five accounts/password123/roles exactly match kittle.json accounts and walls-and-retention.md:3-11; ':13 Dev ... (walled from M-12)' matches seed M-12 walled=[dev]; ':15 Gwen (M-11, M-13)', ':16 Paul (M-12)' match matter.client. :20 Key screens (matter list with unread counts, nested replies, reply/edit/delete/copy-link/hold, timer and wall controls, mentions list, search, transcript) match the brief and exist in the golden (app.js/server.js contain Mentions, Transcript, Search, Mark unread, New messages, Copy link, On hold, not available). :27 clock 2026-05-12T11:00:00Z matches seed clock and integration.md:7. Template CHANGE_ME placeholders are all replaced (diff vs template app_context). (2) Every seeded literal in criteria re-derived from kittle.json: M-11 'Pryce lease dispute' 7d, M-12 'Marsh Holdings acquisition', M-13 'Pryce will' 30d; K-1 'original lease scan' 1 May (expired), K-14/K-15 surviving replies with K-15 held; K-10 'Boundary note' at 2026-05-05T11:00:00Z = exactly 7 days, K-11 one second later; K-13 'Probate estimate is 4,200 pounds.' 4 May with version '2,400' (8 days old at 7d timer); K-7 held executor message; K-2 held 'Landlord's notice received and filed.' with version 'Landlords notice recieved.'; K-17 held 'Insurer letter acknowledged.' 3 May; K-3 'Survey booked for Friday.'; K-16 'Pasted from the lease:' contains 'On hold' and javascript: text; K-6 'Draft heads of terms ready for comment.', 'Fenwick' (K-5), 'Schedule 4' (K-12); K-8 'Draft will sent for your review.'. functional/judge.toml lines 40-241 all agree. (3) Prompt structure is consistent with config: functional/prompt.md:70 'Each session grades one criterion' matches functional/judge.toml:6 mode='individual'; :59 'persistence criterion is last' matches judge.toml order (17 criteria, persistence last, matches the '17 x 520' comment); polish/visual prompts are batched and say so implicitly; render/constraints gates name gwen@kittle.test and 'Kittle & Rowe matter chat'. polish/prompt.md:32 and visual/prompt.md:49 name M-11/M-13/transcript, all real. Grep of all tests/ and instructions for sibling product names (hireops, colderwater, bazaar, gridforge, threadline, patchpad, etc.) and generic residue (CHANGE_ME, lorem, candidate, ticket, acme, example.com except the deliberate payload URL) finds nothing in judge-facing text. ONE instance of other-work residue reported: tests/scored/functional/judge.toml:11-12 TOML comment '# Template default is batched/9000; individual mode is the lead's instruction, relayed # by the task owner on 8 Oct 2026 (same exception as HireOps and Colderwater).' This is not rendered into the judge prompt (TOML comment), so it does not mis-describe the app to the judge, but it names two sibling tasks and internal process in a shipped dimension file, which a hosted reviewer applying 'no residue from other work' literally could flag. Adversarial check: a broken app cannot exploit any prompt inaccuracy because every seeded fact is correct; a conforming app is not failed by a wrong account, matter, or literal. Things outside this row noted but not judged here: visual matter_sidebar anchor wants the timer label in the list and the client name beneath (rows 27/41 territory); live_updates_keep_my_work depends on Harriet already having a message in M-13 (from nested_replies), which is a cross-criterion dependency, not residue.
counterexample: A hosted QC reviewer greps the shipped tests/scored/functional/judge.toml, reads line 12 '(same exception as HireOps and Colderwater)' and flags row 48 for residue from other work. No judge-facing misdescription exists.
suggested_fix: Shorten the comment at tests/scored/functional/judge.toml:11-12 to state only the reason (for example 'Individual mode per lead instruction, 8 Oct 2026; budget 17 x 520 + 900 + 900 = 10640 s'), dropping the sibling task names. Comment-only change; keep the authorization record in the repo outside the task folder.
